name: Mounted Fury
summary: A mounted barbarian whose speed and rage empower a loyal feral mount.

features.name: Fast Rider
features.summary: Increase the speed of any mount you ride by 10 feet.

features.name: Bestial Mount
features.summary: Gain a rideable animal companion using your barbarian level –4 as effective druid level; it gains +2 Strength while you rage mounted.
